comment: Known issues and limits of the emulator on the evaluated hosts, kept by hand. The results page (index.html) shows them under the support matrix, which it builds from evaluation/verification/. Not a result record. 'hosts' and 'modes' say where an issue applies ('all', or a list of host ids / emulator variants). 'kind' is one of: fails (a verification check fails because of it), limit (works, with a restriction), unverified (no host could check it), missing (not implemented). The task list (openspec/changes/staged-emulator-delivery/tasks.md) has the full account of each.

issues.title: No Vulkan on the ARM32 target
issues.detail: Vulkan is drawn by Mesa's CPU driver there, which crashes on 32-bit ARM. Video through Vulkan fails for the same reason.

issues.title: No Flutter on the ARM32 target
issues.detail: The Flutter SDK builds Linux applications for x86-64 and ARM64 only, so the ARM32 image has no Flutter application. Video through Flutter fails for the same reason.

issues.title: The display service is unstable on the ARM32 target
issues.detail: The Wayland compositor ends without a message now and then, on every host. The media and browser workloads start the display again and repeat; the graphics workload does not, so a graphics check can fail on one run and pass on the next. The cause is not known.

issues.title: Host GPU graphics in container mode is verified nowhere
issues.detail: Linux: the host's GPU has NVIDIA's own driver, which the target's Mesa cannot draw with. macOS and Windows: the container engine's virtual machine has no GPU. A Linux host with an Intel or AMD GPU is needed to check this path.

issues.title: macOS: no host GPU graphics with the QEMU that setup installs
issues.detail: Homebrew's QEMU has no GPU-accelerated display device. An experimental QEMU build (./setup.sh --experimental-qemu) gives OpenGL ES on the host GPU in QEMU's own window; it is not part of the verified setup.

issues.title: Windows: host GPU graphics only in QEMU's own window, and not checked automatically
issues.detail: QEMU on Windows shows a display drawn on the host GPU nowhere but in its own window, which has no toolbar and takes no remote control keys, and offers no capture of it. It was checked by hand. QEMU also ends with an access violation after the target has shut down; the results are complete by then.

issues.title: Linux: a 4K display is cut off in the launcher's window in VM mode
issues.detail: QEMU 8.2 serves no more than 2560x2048 pixels to the window, so it shows the top left part of a 4K display, and the launcher says so. --option window=qemu shows all of it in QEMU's own window, without toolbar or remote control keys. QEMU 11 (macOS, Windows) serves all of it. Captures of a 4K display drawn on the host GPU are cut the same way; the checks compare that part and confirm the whole frame with emulated graphics.

issues.title: macOS: full screen needs the window to be the active application
issues.detail: A window started from a background session, and not made active by the system, reports full screen without growing; the check then says unavailable, and why.

issues.title: Flutter shows about a third of a video's frames
issues.detail: Of a 25 frames/s 720p stream, with emulated and with host graphics alike. The application gets decoded frames from a separate decoder and turns each into an image; one that shows video through a texture is not built.

issues.title: Sound from two target programs is not mixed
issues.detail: The target's audio device takes one player at a time.

issues.title: macOS: the sound checks do not record what left the output device
issues.detail: macOS has no private output device without installing an audio driver. The checks play at volume 0 and go by what the system's audio queue took and by the audio server's report of the player.

issues.title: The simulated ARM targets draw web pages far below real time
issues.detail: With the CPU emulated the test page renders at 0.05 to 3 frames/s, and most frames of an MSE stream do not reach the display on macOS and Windows. On Linux, where these targets draw through the host GPU, an ARM64 target loses few frames.

issues.title: TEXT has no key symbol in the target, and play shares one with play/pause
issues.detail: Both keys arrive with their own key codes. The image's browser is not an HbbTV browser, so what an HbbTV application would receive for each key is not settled.

issues.title: RedRat IR input
issues.detail: Not implemented; the launcher says so when it is asked for. No evaluation host has a RedRat device.

issues.title: STB simulator
issues.detail: The set-top-box user interface, its channel list with playback, the app launcher with the VOD application, and starting the performance workloads from it. Only the requirements exist.

issues.title: Full matrix run, comparison report, and disk space and time measurements
issues.detail: The complete host matrix has not been run, the Slidev comparison is not written, and almost every value in evaluation/footprint.md is not measured yet.

issues.title: Hosts of the matrix that have not been run
issues.detail: macOS on x86-64, and Ubuntu 22.04 and 26.04 (the Linux host is Kubuntu 24.04). The setup script's dnf, zypper and pacman paths were run in containers only.
